panel.title: AI assistant
empty.title: AI is not configured
empty.body: Add a provider with an API key to start chatting.
empty.details: Configure it right here in this panel. Commands from the AI always need your confirmation and are copied by default.
chat.empty.title: Ask about this host
chat.empty.body: Paste an error, ask for a command, or select terminal text and hit “Explain selection”. Context is never sent until you approve the preview.
context.beforeSend: You will review the payload first
context.previewHint: Review it before sending — last {{lines}} terminal lines are included, about {{size}} characters total.
command.confirmBody: The command below will be written to the active terminal and executed.
command.defaultCopy: Prefer copying? Cancel and use “Copy” on the card.
danger.rm-force: Deletes files without confirmation (rm -f, no recycle bin)
danger.rm-recursive-root: Targets the filesystem root, home directory or all files
danger.disk-write: Writes raw data to a block device (dd / > /dev/sdX)
danger.shutdown: Shuts down or reboots the machine
danger.permission-wide: Recursively changes permissions on a root path
danger.remote-script: Pipes a remote script straight into a shell
danger.sql-destructive: Destructive SQL (DROP / TRUNCATE / DELETE without WHERE)
provider.title: AI providers
provider.field.name: Name
provider.field.apiKey.placeholder: Paste key — stored in the encrypted vault
provider.hint.keyVault: The key is written to the encrypted vault only; the panel shows the last 4 characters.
provider.hint.headers: One per line, `Name: value`. Sent with every request (e.g. HTTP-Referer for OpenRouter).
provider.error.maxTokens: Max tokens must be an integer between 1 and 200000.
provider.error.name: Name is required.
provider.list.title: Configured providers
provider.list.hint: Save the provider once to make it usable in chat.
templates.title: Prompt templates
templates.hint: Templates are stored locally on this device. Use {{selection}} for the selected terminal text and {{goal}} for your request.
usage.unknown: token usage not reported by this provider
notice.copyFailed: Clipboard unavailable — select the command manually.
error.noProvider: Select a provider first (Settings → AI providers).
error.vaultLocked: The vault is locked. Unlock it to manage AI keys.
error.aiProvider: The provider is not usable: check the model, key and base URL.
error.network: Network error: the provider could not be reached.
error.invalidArgument: Invalid argument — check the model name and parameters.
disabled.title: AI assistant is turned off
disabled.body: AI only runs on providers you configure; nothing is sent while it is off.
disabled.details: Turn it on in Settings → AI, pick a default provider, then come back. Providers and keys live inside the encrypted vault.
locked.title: Vault is locked
locked.body: Unlock it to read providers and keys. Nothing is sent to any provider while locked.
locked.details: Keys live inside the encrypted vault — that is also why hostnames stay hidden while locked. Unlock, press “Try again”, or open Settings → AI.
provider.readonly.hint: Provider names, endpoints and API keys are configured in Settings → AI. This panel only picks one for the conversation.
provider.fetchModels.hint: Ask the provider for the real model list (GET /models)
provider.mode.label: How to create
provider.delete.hint: Deleting means re-entering the API key later
provider.effortAnthropicBudget: This level needs an output limit of at least {{min}}: this request is raised to {{effective}}, your saved {{current}} is unchanged.
provider.effortAnthropicTemperature: Requests with thinking enabled do not send temperature; your saved {{value}} stays as is.
provider.advanced.title: Advanced
provider.models.hint: Ask the provider for its real model list; works as soon as a key is filled in, no save required.
provider.models.count: Loaded {{count}} models · pick one or type your own
provider.models.empty: The provider returned an empty list: check that the base URL points at a compatible endpoint
provider.models.needKey: Fill in an API key before loading models
provider.models.noMatch: No matching model · press Enter to use "{{value}}"
provider.models.error.auth: Authentication failed: check the key and organisation access
provider.models.error.hint.auth: Check that the key is valid and is allowed to use this endpoint
provider.models.error.network: Cannot connect: check the base URL and network
provider.models.error.hint.network: Check the base URL, the network and any proxy settings
provider.models.error.shape: HTTP {{status}} · the response is not a model list
provider.models.error.hint.shape: Make sure the base URL points at a compatible endpoint (usually ending in /v1)
provider.models.error.failed: Could not load the model list
